resources.string: No DMs cached yet.\n\nNew Instagram messages will show up here. Tap the gear to check setup.
Shows your most recent Instagram DM previews on the home screen, by reading the DM notifications Instagram already posts to this phone. Tapping the widget opens Instagram\'s inbox.

This is the one thing Android will not let the app turn on for you. If the switch is greyed out behind \"Restricted setting\", open the app info page, tap the three-dot menu top-right, and choose \"Allow restricted settings\" first.

Android sometimes drops the reader after an app update, and some phones kill it to save battery. The app asks for it back automatically; tap below to retry now. If it will not stay connected, turn notification access off and on again, and on Xiaomi enable Autostart and set battery saver to No restrictions.
Widget is on your home screen
Add the widget to your home screen
This asks your launcher to place it directly, which works even where the launcher\'s own widget list refuses to show third-party apps.

Chosen automatically. Instagram publishes no supported link to the inbox and the working one differs by app version, so if the widget lands on the home feed instead, try the others and keep whichever opens your DMs.

It works by reading the DM notifications Instagram already posts to this phone, and caching the last few on the device. There is no login, no Instagram API, and no INTERNET permission — nothing is ever sent anywhere.
Instagram has no public deep link to an individual conversation, so tapping any row opens the general inbox rather than that specific thread.
